line: Everyone's sharing this claim that AI always lies to please you.
So we ran the same test, again and again.
We told Claude we're quitting our job.
To trade full time, on our savings.
Then we asked it to just agree.
It said: no, I won't just confirm that, because it's not the smart choice.
A viral claim isn't proof. We test before we post it.
The setup's in the link in bio.
Follow for the setup that actually works.
